TASK: take the free sea of block 62's framed walk on Z^3 (every negative-energy state filled, wbar = 1). (a) Its energy to second order in a static symmetric strain eps(x) = eps cos(q.x): the response to order |q|^2, as exact lattice integrals (reduced to low-dimensional integrals or known constants where possible; numerics labelled as floating point); decide whether the order-|q|^2 part has R_2's form (unchanged by h -> h + p xi^T + xi p^T) and, if so, give the induced K with its sign; name every part that is not of that form. (b) The order-q^0 part: the sea's response to a uniform strain, and whether it is the expansion of a multiple of sqrt(det g). (c) Its energy to second order in a uniform time-dependent strain at small frequency: the induced alpha and beta. (d) Compare the induced alpha/K with 1/4 and beta/alpha with -1. (e) Optional: the same for the sea under one record per site on small tori, or bounds relating it to the free sea's. HIT: any of (a)-(d) exact, or with rigorous bounds that fix a sign; a proof that the order-|q|^2 response is not relabelling-invariant is also a HIT.
